Raft Consensus Invariants & Quorum Protection
  • Leader Election: Candidates solicit votes across peers. A leader is only confirmed when receiving strict majority votes: quorum = (N/2) + 1.
  • Log Matching Property: If two logs contain an entry with the same index and term, then the logs are identical in all entries up through the given index.
  • Split-Brain Immunity: Isolated partitions containing fewer than majority quorum nodes cannot elect a leader or commit mutations.
  • Automatic State Reconciliation: Follower logs that conflict with the leader are automatically truncated and overwritten with leader entries.

Zero-Trust Cryptokey Routing & NAT Invariants
  • Zero-Trust Ingress Filtering: Inbound packets are decrypted and inspected. If the decrypted inner packet source IP does not match the sender peer's AllowedIPs list, the packet is instantly dropped.
  • Cryptokey Routing Table: Outgoing overlay packets look up the longest prefix match in the route table to find the target peer's public key for symmetric AEAD encryption.
  • Dynamic NAT Hole Punching & Endpoint Roaming: When an authentic packet is received from a peer whose public IP/port has changed due to NAT re-binding, the gateway dynamically updates the peer's active endpoint.
  • Anti-Replay Protection: A 64-packet bitmap sliding window strictly rejects replayed packets or out-of-order stale packets.

🔀 Dynamic Percentage Split Pipeline
  • Zero Packet Loss Handoff: Thread-safe atomic weight adjustment without socket resets or dropped HTTP connections.
  • Sticky Session Affinity: Deterministic FNV-1a hash routing on HeaderAffinity (e.g. X-User-ID) ensures returning users consistently hit the same version.
  • Canary Header Force: Dedicated override header (e.g. X-Canary-Force: true) allows QA engineers to route internal test requests to canary 100%.
  • Automated Step Promotion: If enabled, periodically increments canary weight in steps (e.g. +10%) when health score remains above threshold.
👥 Asynchronous Shadow Traffic Mirroring
  • Non-Blocking Duplication: Clones real production ingress payloads into an isolated bounded worker pool channel.
  • Zero User Latency Impact: Shadow requests execute in background goroutines; client responses return exclusively from the primary baseline container.
  • Queue Overflow Protection: Fixed-capacity ring queue drops shadow copies if canary slows down, strictly defending primary memory and throughput.
  • Pre-Release Profiling: Evaluates new releases against 100% production workloads without risking user transaction errors.
